config.awsAccessKeyId.description: For S3 sync and translation (Amazon Translate). Leave the access key ID and the secret access key empty to use your AWS CLI credentials (environment variables, the profile in ~/.aws, SSO).
config.awsAccessKeyId.title: AWS access key ID
config.awsRegion.description: For example ap-northeast-1. Empty: the region of your AWS CLI profile, or us-east-1. S3 sync follows the bucket's region by itself.
config.awsRegion.title: AWS region
config.awsSecretAccessKey.description: Set it together with the access key ID. It is saved in your settings file as it is.
config.awsSecretAccessKey.title: AWS secret access key
config.deprecated.aws: Replaced by fractal.awsAccessKeyId / awsSecretAccessKey / awsRegion (one setting for S3 sync and translation). Moved automatically.
config.deprecated.pdfIncludeDefaultStyle: No longer used: the built-in print stylesheet is always included (override it with fractal.pdfStyles).
config.deprecated.terminology: Replaced by fractal.translateTerminology (a file, or the name of a terminology in Amazon Translate). Moved automatically.
config.deprecated.translateLangs: No longer a setting: the translate popup remembers the languages you chose last.
config.enableDebugLogging.description: Write debug logs to the editor's developer tools console. For troubleshooting.
config.enableDebugLogging.title: Debug logging
config.fontSize.title: Font size
config.imageMaxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels of images and draw.io diagrams in the editor. Double-click an image to see it full screen.
config.imageMaxWidth.title: Maximum image width
config.language.description: The language of Fractal's screens. Default: the same as VS Code (the desktop app: the system).
config.language.title: Language
config.pdfBrowserPath.description: PDF export uses Chrome, Edge, Chromium or Brave. Empty: found automatically. If it is not found, set the path of the browser's program.
config.pdfBrowserPath.title: Browser for PDF export
config.pdfStyles.description: CSS files added after the built-in print stylesheet when exporting to PDF (later files win). Absolute paths, ~, or relative to the workspace.
config.pdfStyles.title: CSS for PDF export
config.resourceRoots.description: Folders the editor may load images and attachments from. Empty: anywhere in your home folder. Absolute paths or paths starting with ~ (e.g. ~/notes, /Volumes/ext/notes). Takes effect when you reopen the editor.
config.resourceRoots.title: Folders for images and attachments
config.showOpenInTextEditor.description: The button that opens the file as plain text (VS Code: its text editor; the desktop app: the system's app for the file).
config.showOpenInTextEditor.title: Show "Open in Text Editor"
config.showTranslateButtons.description: Translate buttons in the markdown toolbar and the side panel header. Without them you can still translate with "Fractal: Translate" (⌘/).
config.showTranslateButtons.title: Show translate buttons
config.theme.description: Light, dark, or automatic (follows the system; in VS Code, the color theme).
config.theme.title: Theme
config.toolbarMode.description: The markdown editor's toolbar. Simple: undo, redo and tools (the other commands with ⌘/ or Ctrl+/). Full: the formatting buttons too.
config.toolbarMode.title: Toolbar
config.translateTerminology.description: A CSV or TMX file of your terms (absolute, ~, or relative to the workspace), or the name of a terminology already in Amazon Translate. Upload a file with "Fractal: Update Translate Terminology" (it is named after the file).
config.translateTerminology.title: Translation terminology
config.viewerHtmlAllowScripts.descriptio: Run the scripts of HTML files opened in the file viewer, in a sandbox (no access to your files; fetch / XHR are blocked). Each file can still be switched with the viewer's "Allow scripts" button.
config.viewerHtmlAllowScripts.title: Run scripts in HTML files
